WITH HighSchools AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    School,
    GSserved
  FROM schools
  WHERE NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND StatusType = 'Operational'
    AND GSserved IS NOT NULL
),
SATsBySchool AS (
  SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS TotalTakers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
),
NoSATSchools AS (
  SELECT HS.CDSCode, HS.School, HS.GSserved
  FROM HighSchools HS
  LEFT JOIN SATsBySchool S ON HS.CDSCode = S.cds
  WHERE (S.TotalTakers IS NULL OR S.TotalTakers = 0)
),
SchoolWithMinGrade AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    School,
    CASE
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Preschool%' THEN 1
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Kindergarten%' THEN 2
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Grade 1%' THEN 3
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Grade 2%' THEN 4
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Grade 3%' THEN 5
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Grade 4%' THEN 6
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Grade 5%' THEN 7
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Grade 6%' THEN 8
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Grade 7%' THEN 9
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Grade 8%' THEN 10
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Grade 9%' THEN 11
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Grade 10%' THEN 12
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Grade 11%' THEN 13
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Grade 12%' THEN 14
      ELSE 999
    END AS min_rank,
    GSserved
  FROM NoSATSchools
  WHERE GSserved LIKE '%12%'
),
EarliestGradeRank AS (
  SELECT MIN(min_rank) AS earliest_rank FROM SchoolWithMinGrade
)
SELECT School, GSserved
FROM SchoolWithMinGrade
WHERE min_rank = (SELECT earliest_rank FROM EarliestGradeRank)
ORDER BY School
LIMIT 1000

WITH ActiveCharters AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    FundingType,
    CAST(GSserved AS INTEGER) AS Enrollment,
    CASE
      WHEN EILCode IS NOT NULL AND EILCode GLOB '*[0-9]*' THEN CAST(EILCode AS REAL) * 100
      ELSE NULL
    END AS FRPM_Percent
  FROM schools
  WHERE Charter = 1
    AND StatusType = 'Open'
    AND FundingType IN ('Directly Funded', 'Locally Funded')
),
SATData AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    (IFNULL(AvgScrRead, 0) + IFNULL(AvgScrMath, 0) + IFNULL(AvgScrWrite, 0)) AS TotalSAT
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'charter'

)

WITH monthly_openings AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', OpenDate) AS year_month,
    COUNT(*) AS schools_opened
  FROM schools
  WHERE OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'
    AND County = 'San Diego'
  GROUP BY year_month
), all_months AS (
  SELECT '1980-01' AS year_month UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-02' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-03' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-04' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-05' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-06' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-07' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-08' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-09' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-10' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-11' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-12'
), monthly_openings_filled AS (
  SELECT m.year_month, COALESCE(o.schools_opened, 0) AS schools_opened
  FROM all_months m
  LEFT JOIN monthly_openings o ON m.year_month = o.year_month
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(schools_opened) AS FLOAT) / 12 AS avg_schools_opened_per_month
FROM monthly_openings_filled;

WITH ParsedGradeEnds AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, Charter, GSserved,
    TRIM(SUBSTR(GSserved, INSTR(GSserved, '-') + 1)) AS GradeEnd
  FROM schools
  WHERE County = 'Alameda'
), ValidSchools AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM ParsedGradeEnds
  WHERE GradeEnd = '12' OR GradeEnd = 'K-12' OR GradeEnd = 'P-12'
), MaxFreeMeal AS (
  SELECT MAX([Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)]) AS MaxFreeMealRate
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN ValidSchools vs ON f.CDSCode = vs.CDSCode
  WHERE f.[County Name] = 'Alameda'
), SchoolsWithMaxFreeMeal AS (
  SELECT f.CDSCode, f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)]
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN ValidSchools vs ON f.CDSCode = vs.CDSCode
  WHERE f.[County Name] = 'Alameda' AND f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] = (SELECT MaxFreeMealRate FROM MaxFreeMeal)
), SATPerformance AS (
  SELECT cds,
    CASE
      WHEN NumTstTakr = 0 OR NumTstTakr IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
      WHEN (COALESCE(AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(AvgScrWrite, 0)) / 3.0 < 1500 THEN 'Below Average'
      WHEN (COALESCE(AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(AvgScrWrite, 0)) / 3.0 BETWEEN 1500 AND 1800 THEN 'Average'
      ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS SAT_Level
  FROM satscores
), Result AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, ROUND(swmax.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)], 4) AS FreeMealRate,
    CASE s.Charter WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS CharterStatus,
    s.GSserved AS GradesServed,
    COALESCE(sp.SAT_Level, 'No SAT Data') AS SATPerformance

    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY VirtualCount DESC) AS RankDesc
  FROM CountyVirtualCounts
),

  WHERE s.releaseDate = (
    SELECT MIN(s2.releaseDate)

),

  FROM CombinedSets cs
  LEFT JOIN CardsWithManaCosts cwmc ON cs.code = cwmc.setCode

    SELECT

LoanStandingLabel AS (
  SELECT account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN loans_count = 0 THEN 'no loan'

      ELSE 'paid off'
    END AS loan_standing
  FROM LoansUpTo1996
),
Trans1997 AS (
  SELECT account_id,
    COUNT(trans_id) AS trans_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'cash_withdrawal') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,

  FROM trans

  GROUP BY account_id
),

  SELECT
    a.account_id,

    oi.gender,

  FROM AccountsAt1996End a

  LEFT JOIN CardsCount cc ON a.account_id = cc.account_id
  LEFT JOIN LoansUpTo1996 lu ON a.account_id = lu.account_id

  LEFT JOIN Trans1997 t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
),

  SELECT *,

  FROM AccountProfiles

       gender,
       age_at_1996_12_31 AS age,
       cards_count,
       loans_count,
       loan_standing,

  FROM qualifying

  SELECT driverId, q1,
    (CAST(substr(q1, 1, instr(q1, ':')-1) AS FLOAT) * 60 + CAST(substr(q1, instr(q1, ':')+1) AS FLOAT)) AS q1_seconds
  FROM q1_times
), max_q1 AS (
  SELECT MAX(q1_seconds) AS slowest_time
  FROM parsed_q1

  SELECT p.driverId, p.q1
  FROM parsed_q1 p
  JOIN max_q1 m ON p.q1_seconds = m.slowest_time
)

  GROUP BY PatientID

)

SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY carbon_touching_bonds DESC, num_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC) AS rank,
  m.molecule_id,
  m.carcinogenicity AS carcinogenicity_label,
  ac.num_atoms,
  COALESCE(bc.num_bonds, 0) AS num_bonds,
  ac.num_carbons,
  ac.num_chlorines,
  COALESCE(bc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
  COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS multiple_bonds
FROM molecule_info m
JOIN atom_counts ac ON m.molecule_id = ac.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON m.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
WHERE ac.num_carbons > 0
ORDER BY carbon_touching_bonds DESC, num_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC;

WITH molecule_with_yttrium AS (

    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'Yttrium'
),
hydrogen_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id, molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'Hydrogen'
),
hydrogen_bonds AS (
    SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    JOIN molecule_with_yttrium my ON b.molecule_id = my.molecule_id
    JOIN hydrogen_atoms ha ON ha.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM atom a
        WHERE a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND (a.atom_id = ha.atom_id)
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS hydrogen_bond_count
FROM hydrogen_bonds;

WITH y_molecule AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'Yttrium'
), hydrogen_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
  WHERE (a1.element = 'Hydrogen' OR a2.element = 'Hydrogen')
    AND (a1.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM y_molecule) OR a2.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM y_molecule))
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_bond_count
FROM hydrogen_bonds;

WITH non_carc_bonds AS (
  SELECT b.bond_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label != 'carcinogenic' AND b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
),
bond_connections AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
  FROM connected c
  JOIN non_carc_bonds ncb ON c.bond_id = ncb.bond_id
),
atom_elements AS (
  SELECT atom_id, element
  FROM atom
),
carbon_bonds AS (
  SELECT
    bc.bond_id,
    CASE
      WHEN ae1.element = 'C' THEN ae2.element
      WHEN ae2.element = 'C' THEN ae1.element
      ELSE NULL
    END AS other_element
  FROM bond_connections bc
  JOIN atom_elements ae1 ON bc.atom_id = ae1.atom_id
  JOIN atom_elements ae2 ON bc.atom_id2 = ae2.atom_id
  WHERE ae1.element = 'C' OR ae2.element = 'C'
)
SELECT other_element AS element, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM carbon_bonds
WHERE other_element IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY other_element
ORDER BY other_element;

WITH metal_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element IN ('Li', 'Be', 'Na', 'Mg', 'Al', 'K', 'Ca', 'Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn', 'Ga', 'Rb', 'Sr', 'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd', 'In', 'Sn', 'Cs', 'Ba', 'La', 'Ce', 'Pr', 'Nd', 'Pm', 'Sm', 'Eu', 'Gd', 'Tb', 'Dy', 'Ho', 'Er', 'Tm', 'Yb', 'Lu', 'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg', 'Tl', 'Pb', 'Bi', 'Po', 'Fr', 'Ra', 'Ac', 'Th', 'Pa', 'U')
),
non_carcinogenic AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label != 'carcinogenic'
),
molecules_with_single_bonds AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT bond_type) = 1
     AND MAX(bond_type) = 'single'
)
SELECT molecule_id
FROM non_carcinogenic
INNER JOIN metal_molecules USING (molecule_id)
INNER JOIN molecules_with_single_bonds USING (molecule_id)
ORDER BY molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH atom_bond_types AS (
  SELECT
    c.atom_id,
    a.element,
    b.bond_type
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
), atom_bond_summary AS (
  SELECT
    atom_id,
    element,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN bond_type = 'single' THEN 1 END) AS single_bond_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN bond_type != 'single' THEN 1 END) AS multiple_bond_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_bonds
  FROM atom_bond_types
  GROUP BY atom_id, element
)
SELECT
  element,
  COUNT(*) AS fully_saturated_single_bond_atoms
FROM atom_bond_summary
WHERE total_bonds > 0
  AND single_bond_count = total_bonds
  AND multiple_bond_count = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = 'triple'
), element_molecule AS (
    SELECT element, molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM triple_bond_molecules)
    GROUP BY element, molecule_id
), element_molecule_count AS (
    SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
    FROM element_molecule
    GROUP BY element
)
SELECT element AS element_symbol, molecule_count
FROM element_molecule_count
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

WITH molecule_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, element
  FROM atom a
  JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = 'TR397'
),
bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT atom_id FROM (
    SELECT c.atom_id FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE b.molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR397')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.atom_id2 as atom_id FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE b.molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR397')
  )
)
SELECT ma.element, COUNT(DISTINCT ba.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM molecule_atoms ma
JOIN bonded_atoms ba ON ma.atom_id = ba.atom_id
GROUP BY ma.element
ORDER BY ma.element ASC;
